propagation.summary: Free IR-inspired algorithmic reverb that turns captured spaces into editable size, density, width, clarity, and motion controls.
propagation.update: Updated to v1.5.0. Adds small refinements to the IR-inspired reverb workflow and current public downloads.

sourcefield.summary: Free 2D source placement plug-in for ASMR-like mono, stereo, and 5.1 positioning, with blur-based spatial softening, source direction, listener perspective, distance-style tone shaping, motion drift, and input-reactive visual feedback from an XY field.
sourcefield.update: Updated to v1.5.0. Adds 5.1ch support and keeps placement as a blurred spatial source with distance-style depth instead of collapsing it into a point source.

bandmatrix.summary: Free variable-band sidechain dynamics plug-in with compression, expansion, flexible matrix routing, and Inverse sidechain mode.
bandmatrix.update: Updated to v3.2.0. Adds variable band count support and more flexible matrix routing for sidechain dynamics workflows.

panblur.summary: Free spatial enhancer for mono, LCR, and 5.1 sources that creates intimate stereo images without moving their pan position.
panblur.update: Updated to v1.8.0. Includes bug fixes and stability refinements for the spatial-enhancer workflow.

dialoguedoctor.summary: Free dialogue cleanup plug-in for voice and post-production, with separate sibilance and residual processing for more consistent speech.
dialoguedoctor.update: Development is continuing and the release has been postponed. Dialogue Doctor has not been cancelled, and we remain committed to releasing it.

texturematch.summary: Reference-based character matching plug-in that matches more than a static EQ curve.

levelrangeeq.summary: Free level-dependent EQ plug-in with separate curves for quiet, mid-level, and loud parts, plus Tone Shaper and Dynamic EQ workflows.
levelrangeeq.update: Updated to v2.4.0. Includes minor bug fixes while retaining the Tone Shaper and Dynamic EQ workflows.

phaseslice.summary: Free multi-band phase and timing shaper for tightening drums, transients, and frequency-specific timing problems.
phaseslice.update: Updated to v1.2.1. This release may resolve a loading issue in some environments, but that is not fully confirmed yet.

distance.summary: Free psychoacoustic distance plug-in for pushing close sounds farther back without obvious reverb.
distance.update: Updated to v1.0.1. This release may resolve a loading issue in some environments, but that is not fully confirmed yet.

dsptrace.summary: Beta plug-in analyzer for loading AU/VST processors, sweeping parameters, and turning compressor, EQ, saturation, timing, and automation behavior into repeatable trace graphs.
dsptrace.update: Updated to v1.1.0. Includes bug fixes for the beta plug-in analyzer workflow.

weavegate.summary: Multiband gate and spectral expander for shaping how frequency regions open, close, influence each other, and transition over time.
weavegate.update: Updated to v1.4.0. Open and Close now use direction-aware hysteresis, with clearer live state feedback and matching behavior across crossover and spectral processing.

spectralleveler.summary: Real-time spectral dynamics plug-in for smoothing harshness and uneven resonances with frequency, level, sidechain, and inter-band reduction control.
spectralleveler.update: Updated to v1.4.0. Includes minor bug fixes for spectral leveling and harshness control.

studiomate.summary: iPad recording-session app that adds timecode markers to PDFs and jumps your DAW back to the marked spot.
studiomate.update: Updated to v3.5. Improves PDF import, sharing, export, page progress, resizable thumbnails, and the Pro Tools MIDI Input Devices setup guide.

pocketcamviewer.summary: iPhone, iPad, and Mac camera-monitor app that turns one Apple device into a camera and another into a viewer.

harmonycounterpoint.summary: Music theory, ear-training, and composition-practice app for harmony, counterpoint, orchestration, instrumentation, solfege, and jazz study.
harmonycounterpoint.update: Updated to v2.6. Refines counterpoint evaluation for octaves and idiomatic third-species passing dissonances, and avoids unnatural consecutive repetitions in Styles examples.

scoreshelf.summary: Free iPad sheet music library for managing PDFs, reading scores, adding light Apple Pencil notes, bookmarking pages, and tracking practice spots.
scoreshelf.update: Updated to v1.2. Adds support for remotely turning pages from another iOS device.

quicksearchext.summary: Safari extension for searching selected text on your favorite sites from iPhone, iPad, or Mac.

copyskipper.summary: macOS one-way folder sync app that makes rsync-style copying easier to review, repeat, and trust.
copyskipper.update: Updated to v2.0. Added Finder tag sync. Finder comment sync is not supported due to Apple limitations.

calendarcalendar.summary: macOS desktop calendar widget with customizable colors, fonts, weekend styling, and readable month layouts.

audiofolderinspector.summary: macOS Finder Quick Action for inspecting audio folders, checking loudness and file specifications, auditioning waveforms, and exporting HTML/CSV reports. Requires Python 3 and FFmpeg.
audiofolderinspector.update: Audio Folder Inspector v8 is available for Mac. Inspect audio folders from Finder with quality categories, waveform playback, CSV export, and seven report languages.

padmachine.summary: Customizable macro controller for Mac with trackpad gestures, on-demand trackpad numpad, visual macro editor, and a browser-based 16-pad iPhone or iPad controller.
padmachine.update: PAD Machine 0.9.3 improves keyboard input, common PAD macro execution, timed mouse capture and pixel-based scrolling.

zh-Hans.heading: 免费音频插件与实用的 macOS/iOS 应用
zh-Hans.intro: 面向混音、空间处理、录音、音乐练习和日常工作流程的免费工具。大多数音频插件支持 macOS，兼容产品的页面也提供 Windows VST3 版本。
zh-Hans.compat: macOS 版本面向 macOS 11 及以上系统。对应产品页面也提供 Windows VST3 ZIP 压缩包。
zh-Hans.contactIntro: 如需报告问题或提出功能建议，请通过电子邮件联系：
zh-Hans.contactDetails: 请提供应用名称、应用版本、系统版本、复现步骤，以及尽可能提供截图。
zh-Hans.newsIntro: 音频插件和 macOS/iOS 应用的近期更新。
zh-Hans.englishNotice: 部分链接中的产品文档目前仅提供英文版本。

products.propagation: 受 IR 启发的免费算法混响，可编辑采集空间的大小、密度、宽度、清晰度和运动。
products.sourcefield: 适用于单声道、立体声和 5.1 的免费二维声源定位插件，提供空间模糊、方向、听者视角、距离音色、运动和输入响应式 XY 区域。
products.bandmatrix: 免费可变频段侧链动态插件，支持压缩、扩展、矩阵路由和 Inverse 侧链模式。
products.panblur: 适用于单声道、LCR 和 5.1 的免费空间增强器，无需改变声像位置即可营造亲密立体声声像。
products.dialoguedoctor: 面向语音与后期制作的免费对白清理插件，分别处理齿音与残余成分。
products.texturematch: 基于参考音频匹配声音质感，而非仅匹配静态 EQ 曲线。
products.levelrangeeq: 免费电平相关 EQ，提供低、中、高电平独立曲线及 Tone Shaper 和 Dynamic EQ。
products.phaseslice: 免费多频段相位和时间调整工具，用于鼓、瞬态及特定频率的时间问题。
products.distance: 无需明显混响即可将近处声音推远的免费心理声学距离插件。
products.dsptrace: AU/VST 插件测试版分析器，支持参数扫描以及压缩、EQ、饱和、时间特性与自动化的可重复曲线图。
products.weavegate: 多频段门限与频谱扩展器，可控制频率区域的开闭、相互影响及时间过渡。
products.spectralleveler: 实时频谱动态插件，通过频率、电平、侧链及频段间衰减控制缓解刺耳声与不均匀共振。
products.studiomate: iPad 录音会话应用，可为 PDF 添加时间码标记并让 DAW 跳转至标记位置。
products.pocketcamviewer: iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 摄像监视应用，一台设备作为摄像机，另一台作为监视器。
products.harmonycounterpoint: 涵盖和声、对位法、配器、乐器法、视唱练耳与爵士的音乐理论、听力及作曲练习应用。
products.scoreshelf: 免费 iPad PDF 乐谱库，支持管理、阅读、Apple Pencil 简单注释、书签和练习位置记录。
products.quicksearchext: Safari 扩展，可在 iPhone、iPad 或 Mac 上用喜爱的网站搜索所选文本。
products.copyskipper: macOS 单向文件夹同步应用，让 rsync 式复制更便于检查与重复执行。
products.calendarcalendar: 可自定义颜色、字体、周末样式和月视图的 macOS 桌面日历。
products.audiofolderinspector: macOS Finder 快捷操作：检查音频文件夹、响度及文件规格，试听波形，导出 HTML/CSV 报告。需要 Python 3 和 FFmpeg。
products.padmachine: Mac 可定制宏控制器，提供触控板手势、按需数字键盘、可视化宏编辑器，以及 iPhone/iPad 浏览器 16 键控制面板。
